name: radio-card
title: Radio card
description: Radio options as cards with a title, description and an optional recommended mark: plans, tiers, methods.

when: Choosing a plan or method where each option needs a description.

keyboard.does: Moves and selects within the group.

builtIn: Required fields show "Fill in this field." after a blur or a submit; your own `errorMessage` replaces it.

genui.description: Options as cards (plans, methods). items are {value, title, description?, price?, badge?}. Emits change.
